definitions.gloss: to conclude, to wrap up, to bring to a close
definitions.explanation: To bring something to a fitting conclusion. Used for speeches, events, projects, or any activity that needs a proper ending.

examples.japanese: スピーチを{締|し}め{括|くく}る。
{今年|ことし}を{良|よ}い{形|かたち}で{締|し}め{括|くく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to wrap up this year on a good note.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}に{感謝|かんしゃ}の{言葉|ことば}で{締|し}め{括|くく}った。
examples.english: He concluded with words of gratitude.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スピーチを{締|し}め{括|くく}る: to conclude a speech
- {一年|いちねん}を{締|し}め{括|くく}る: to close out the year
- 〜で{締|し}め{括|くく}る: to wrap up with ~

RELATED NOUN:
- {締|し}め{括|くく}り: conclusion, wrap-up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終|お}える: to finish (neutral, general)
- {まとめる}: to summarize, to put together
- {結|むす}ぶ: to conclude (more formal; used for contracts, agreements)
